#Packages and Data Preparation
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

```

## Load datasets
```{r}
data(iris)
data(mtcars)
data(airquality)
```

## Examine dataset dimensions
```{r}
dim(iris)
dim(mtcars)
dim(airquality)
```
# Display first six observations
```{r}
head(iris)
head(mtcars)
head(airquality)
```
# Visualizations Using the Iris Dataset
```{r}
#Graph 1: geom_point() – Scatterplot
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Species), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Petal Length and Width",
    x = "Petal Length (cm)",
    y = "Petal Width (cm)",
    color = "Flower Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
#Graph 2: geom_boxplot() – Boxplot
```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Sepal Length Distribution by Species",
    x = "Flower Species",
    y = "Sepal Length (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

#Graph 3: geom_histogram() – Histogram
```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 15,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Sepal Length",
    x = "Sepal Length (cm)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
#Graph 4: geom_density()- Density Plot
```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Petal Length Density by Flower Species",
    x = "Petal Length (cm)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
#Graph 5: geom_bar() – Bar Chart
```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Flowers by Species",
    x = "Flower Species",
    y = "Number of Observations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Visualizations Using the Mtcars Dataset
```{r}
#Graph 6: geom_col() – Column Chart
car_average <- mtcars %>%
  group_by(cyl) %>%
  summarise(
    average_mpg = mean(mpg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(car_average, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = average_mpg)) +
  geom_col(fill = "orange") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Fuel Efficiency by Number of Cylinders",
    x = "Number of Cylinders",
    y = "Average Miles Per Gallon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

#Graph 7: geom_violin() – Violin Plot
```{r}
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = cut, y = price)) +
  geom_violin(
    fill = "lightgreen",
    color = "darkgreen",
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Diamond Price Distribution Across Cut Categories",
    x = "Cut Quality",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
#Graph 8: geom_jitter() – Jitter Plot
```{r}
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = cut, y = price)) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = "purple"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Diamond Prices by Cut Category",
    x = "Cut Quality",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
